import sys,json,copy,base64,csv,io,struct,random,itertools,time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/submission','/workspace/deps']
from campaign import audit
from common import COLUMNS,parse_json,Invalid,CaptureError,validate
from gen_targets import plan
from protocols import packet,signature,probe_script
from planning import solve
import zstandard as zstd

base=json.load(open('/workspace/examples/fixtures.json'))[1]['input']
def withrows(rows,job=None,encoding='csv'):
 job=copy.deepcopy(job if job is not None else base)
 s=io.StringIO(newline=''); w=csv.writer(s);w.writerow(COLUMNS);w.writerows(rows)
 data=s.getvalue().encode()
 if encoding=='zstd':data=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(data)
 job['captures']=[{'encoding':encoding,'chunks':[base64.b64encode(data[i:i+13]).decode() for i in range(0,len(data),13)]}]
 return job

def icmp(name='x',rev=0,pub=2,ev=1,probe='0/i1',t='2001:db8:1:1200::1',resp=None,result='echo',op='put'):
 return ['icmp',name,str(rev),str(pub),op,'home',str(ev),probe,t,resp if resp is not None else t,result,'','','']
def app(name='a',rev=0,pub=5,ev=4,t='2001:db8:1:1200::1',result='open',attempt=0,payload=b'',service='web'):
 return ['app',name,str(rev),str(pub),'put','home',str(ev),'',t,'',result,service,str(attempt),base64.b64encode(payload).decode()]
def delete(kind,name,rev,pub):return [kind,name,str(rev),str(pub),'delete']+['']*9

for encoding in ['csv','zstd']:
 r=audit(withrows([icmp(),app()],encoding=encoding));s=r['snapshots'][0]
 assert s['ledger']=={'live':2,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}
 assert s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open']==['2001:db8:1:1200::1']
 assert r['active_requests']==[{'id':'check','active':False}]

# Higher conflicting revisions, publication visibility, withdrawal, resurrection.
j=copy.deepcopy(base);j['queries']=[40,10,30,20]
rows=[icmp(),icmp(rev=1,pub=15,ev=8),icmp(rev=1,pub=17,ev=9),
 delete('icmp','x',2,25),icmp(rev=3,pub=35,ev=34)]
r=audit(withrows(rows,j))
assert [s['ledger'] for s in r['snapshots']]==[
 {'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0},{'live':0,'deleted':0,'conflict':1},
 {'live':0,'deleted':1,'conflict':0},{'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}]
# Semantic duplicate; distinct identity/application causal witness.
x=icmp();y=icmp(pub=3);y[2]='00000';y[6]='0001';y[8]=y[9]='2001:0DB8:0001:1200:0000:0000:0000:0001'
r=audit(withrows([x,y,app(ev=0), app(name='b',attempt=3,result='closed')]))
s=r['snapshots'][0]; assert s['ledger']['live']==3 and s['unbound_applications']==1
assert s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_closed']==[x[8]]
# External discovery, then overlapping conflict. Alias wins but reports conflict.
_,look,_=plan(validate(base)['leases'],'demo')
can=str(__import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address(look['home','0/c'][0]))
rows=[icmp(),icmp(name='ext',probe='0/i2',t='2001:db8:1:1200::2',resp='2001:db8:1:1200::1',result='error'),icmp(name='can',probe='0/c',t=can),app()]
s=audit(withrows(rows))['snapshots'][0];l=s['leases'][0]
assert l['state']=='alias' and l['conflicts']==['2001:db8:1:1200::1'] and not l['internal'] and s['unbound_applications']==1
assert l['unresolved']==['2001:db8:1:1200::1','2001:db8:1:1200::2']
# Status aggregation with eligible latest attempt only and errors per identity.
j=copy.deepcopy(base);j['services'][0]['kind']='adb'
p=packet(0x4e584e43,0x01000203,123,b'banner')
rows=[icmp(),app(payload=p), app(name='b',payload=packet(0x4e584e43,0x00000203,6,b'banner')),
 app(name='c',attempt=0,payload=b'bad'),app(name='d',attempt=1,payload=p)]
s=audit(withrows(rows,j))['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
assert s['internal_open'] and s['protocol_errors']==0
rows[-1][12]='0';s=audit(withrows(rows,j))['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
assert not s['internal_open'] and s['protocol_errors']==1
# malformed rows keep ordinals including blanks.
rows=[[],['blah'],icmp(),delete('icmp','absent',0,1)]
r=audit(withrows(rows));assert r['rejected']==[[0,0],[0,1]] and r['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['deleted']==1
# Protocol wire framing variations
assert signature('adb',p)==('CNXN','0.2.3','banner')
for bad in [p+b'\0',p[:-1],packet(0x45534c43,0,0,b''),p[:16]+b'\0'*4+p[20:],p[:20]+b'\0'*4+p[24:]]:
 assert signature('adb',bad) is None
assert signature('adb',packet(0x48545541,3,5,b'\xff'))==('AUTH',3,5,b'\xff')
import plistlib
f=lambda d: (lambda b:struct.pack('>I',len(b))+b)(plistlib.dumps(d))
d1={'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'17.2'};d2={**d1,'Key':'ProductName','Value':'iPhone'}
sync=f(d1)+f(d2);assert signature('sync',sync)==('sync','17.2','iPhone')
for bad in [sync+b'\0',sync[:-1],b'\0'*4+sync[4:],f(d2)+f(d1),b'',f([])+f(d2)]:assert signature('sync',bad) is None
# Transport frame variants and capture errors.
s=io.StringIO();csv.writer(s).writerow(COLUMNS);text=s.getvalue().encode()
compressed=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(text)
def captest(data,ok=False,enc='zstd'):
 j=copy.deepcopy(base);j['captures']=[{'encoding':enc,'chunks':[base64.b64encode(data).decode()]}]
 try:r=audit(j)
 except CaptureError:assert not ok;return
 assert ok,(data[:30],r)
captest(compressed,True)
captest(compressed[:4]+bytes([compressed[4]|0x10])+compressed[5:],True)
captest(compressed[:4]+bytes([compressed[4]|0x08])+compressed[5:])
captest(compressed[:-1]);captest(compressed+b'x');captest(compressed[:-1]+bytes([compressed[-1]^1]))
frame=lambda t:zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(t)
skip=struct.pack('<II',0x184d2a50,4)+b'abcd'
captest(skip+frame(text[:10])+skip+frame(text[10:])+skip,True)
captest(skip)
for t in [b'\xff',text+b'"unclosed',text+b'"a"x,whatever']:
 captest(t,enc='csv')
print('census/protocol/capture tests passed')

# Exhaustive small assignment oracle checks nested quota optimum.
random.seed(763)
for trial in range(300):
 n=random.randint(1,6);m=random.randint(1,5)
 j=copy.deepcopy(base);j['requests']=[];j['offers']=[]
 for key in ['request_quotas','offer_quotas']:
  j[key]=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':random.randrange(n+1)},
          {'id':'a','parent':'root','capacity':random.randrange(n+1)},
          {'id':'b','parent':'root','capacity':random.randrange(n+1)},
          {'id':'c','parent':'a','capacity':random.randrange(n+1)}]
 for i in range(n):j['requests'].append({**base['requests'][0],'id':f'r{i}','group':random.choice(['root','a','b','c'])})
 for i in range(m):j['offers'].append({**base['offers'][0],'id':f'o{i}','group':random.choice(['root','a','b','c']),
     'cost':random.randrange(10),'capacity':random.randrange(n+1), 'requests':[f'r{k}' for k in range(n) if random.random()<.5]})
 c=validate(j);a={f'r{i}':random.random()<.9 for i in range(n)}
 actual=solve(c,a)
 opts=[]
 for row in j['requests']:
  opts.append([None]+[off['id'] for off in j['offers'] if row['id'] in off['requests'] and a[row['id']]])
 best=(0,0)
 for selected in itertools.product(*opts):
  counts={};cost=0;num=0
  for r,o in zip(j['requests'],selected):
   if o is None:continue
   num+=1;cost+=c['offers'][o]['cost'];counts['o',o]=counts.get(('o',o),0)+1
   for q in c['request_paths'][r['group']]:counts['rq',q]=counts.get(('rq',q),0)+1
   for q in c['offer_paths'][c['offers'][o]['group']]:counts['oq',q]=counts.get(('oq',q),0)+1
  if any(v>(c['offers'] if k=='o' else c['request_quotas'] if k=='rq' else c['offer_quotas'])[name]['capacity'] for (k,name),v in counts.items()):continue
  best=min(best,(-num,cost))
 assert (-actual['resolved'],actual['cost'])==best,(trial,best,actual)
print('300 exhaustive planner tests passed')
